item.title: Agenda updated: Regular Board Meeting (Jan 28, 2027)
item.description:
LA Metro changed the agenda for Regular Board Meeting, Thursday, January 28, 2027 at 6:00 PM PST.

What changed: Item 7, the bus lane contract, was added.

Summary: The board will vote on the K Line extension.

Public comment opens at 6 PM.

item.title: Agenda posted: Regular Board Meeting (Jan 28, 2027)
item.description:
LA Metro posted the agenda for Regular Board Meeting, Thursday, January 28, 2027 at 6:00 PM PST.

Summary: The board will vote on the K Line extension & fares.
